observations.statement: The 2025 prosecution account alleges a June 2020 request for the technical team to replace or revise an operating-system comparison with a Chrome OS-directed study; no signed source drafts attached.
A contemporaneous October 2020 elementary directorate announcement described funding assistance to 2,330 SD schools to purchase specified ICT sets for minimum competency assessment.
The education ministry announced 88,250,000 rupiah transferred per recipient elementary school for a 2020 education-ICT kit; this was per-school assistance, not an audited single laptop price.

The ministry said recipient elementary schools would purchase 15 Chromebooks and a connector via SIPLah, while router and projector procurement would use e-catalog; individual schools' transactions were not listed.

The July 2025 prosecution press release alleges elementary director Sri Wahyuningsih replaced PPK identified by initials BH with another PPK identified by initials WH on June 30 2020; no signed appointment or revocation attached.

The July 2025 prosecution account alleges PPK identified as WH acted on an e-catalog order after meeting a representative identified as IN of PT Bhinneka Mentaridimensi; transaction identity, time and signatory not independently verified.

The same prosecutor account alleges the SMP director instructed PPK identified by initials HS to place a Chrome OS order involving PT Bhinneka Mentaridimensi; this is not verified procurement execution.
The SD Directorate FY2021 performance report states output target and achievement of 4,981 educational equipment packages; reporting an output count does not establish use by pupils.

The January 2022 performance report describes 2021 assistance for 4,981 packages with a nominal allocation of Rp95,000,000 per package; not a proven unit invoice or independently audited purchase price.

In its analysis of the equipment-output program, the 2021 Directorate report describes Rp471,685,757,000 and phased allocations; do not equate this reported program figure to the complete procurement payment ledger.
LKPP Decree 6/2022 identifies PT Bhinneka Mentaridimensi as a digital marketplace partner as of January 26 2022; the later designation does not validate a particular 2020 purchase.
LKPP Circular 9/2022 describes the 2022 national consolidated Chromebook e-catalog for educational DAK Fisik and separate office-use laptop procurement; scope must be checked per funding source.

The LKPP 2022 circular annex lists a Rp5,550,000 ceiling for one domestic Chromebook under a consolidated framework, including Chrome Education Upgrade but excluding freight; it is not comparable without adjustment to 2020 per-school kits.

School recipient acknowledgments and 2020 device acceptance documentation

School-level activation and actual educational utilization records
Signed appointment and revocation for PPK initials BH and WH effective 30 June 2020
Original June 30 e-catalog purchase order and PPK authorization event log
Executed contract or supplier confirmation identifying the buyer and financial terms
Signed SMP PPK HS appointment for June 2020 package and term of authority
Original junior-secondary order identifier and supplier acceptance
Individual school grant recipient package identifiers and budget authority coding for 2021
School 2021 purchase orders and invoice values to reconcile 4,981 output packages
Original report workpapers and recipient acceptance audit trail for 2021
2022 marketplace designation instrument and any actual underlying procurement agreement, not a 2020 award
Actual 2022 DAK purchasing authority, order identifiers and negotiated prices by government buyer
Specific 2022 purchase price build-up, specifications and freight separately from catalogue ceiling
Shipping, serial-number and acceptance evidence for the identified 2022 regional transactions
